name: Cursor recognition and recovery
invariants: Every path advances or terminates; ranges refer to consumed source
failure_policy: Emit the owned diagnostic and recover only at a declared boundary

name: Diagnostic accumulation and first-error latch
invariants: Counts and first error are stable; reset returns to empty
failure_policy: Preserve the first owned error and explicit suppression state
oracle: Exact records counts first error suppression and reset

name: Transactional artifact publication
invariants: Consumers never observe a partial accepted set; confinement holds
failure_policy: Rollback or leave the prior published state intact
oracle: Filesystem and manifest snapshot before during and after failure

name: Cache identity and invalidation
invariants: Key identity and producer revision select the value; failed builds are not ready hits
failure_policy: Do not publish failed or stale values
oracle: Hit/miss/build counters identity and returned object equivalence

name: Owned resource and lifetime transfer
invariants: Single owner where required; borrow never outlives owner; cleanup is balanced
failure_policy: Unwind or clean every acquired resource without double release
oracle: Ownership identities lifetime boundaries and release counts

name: Graph construction transformation and verification
invariants: Edges endpoints and indexes agree; ordering and reachability are deterministic
failure_policy: Latch structural failure and do not expose an accepted malformed graph

name: Compiler pipeline transformation
invariants: Each consumer observes only a valid producer output; provenance survives transitions
failure_policy: Stop at the named stage and publish no downstream success
oracle: Stage result diagnostics provenance and produced artifact set

name: Concurrent job scheduling and cancellation
invariants: Dependencies precede consumers; completion is indexed; cancellation is monotone
failure_policy: Arbitrate deterministically and discard work that cannot be published

name: Process launch supervision and exit
invariants: Arguments and streams remain attributable; exit/fault identity is preserved
failure_policy: Map platform failure once and preserve the producer exit result
oracle: Arguments streams timing fault and exact exit code

name: Snapshot and semantic-index publication
invariants: Versions increase monotonically; a snapshot is immutable after publication
failure_policy: Expose current diagnostics while retaining only an explicitly permitted last valid model
oracle: Version document bytes index identity and diagnostic sequence

name: Configuration option and target resolution
invariants: Precedence is explicit; unknown conflicting or out-of-range input never silently wins
failure_policy: Reject at the owning boundary without hidden fallback unless specified
oracle: Resolved configuration provenance and exact diagnostic

name: Builder and verifier reusable lifecycle
invariants: First error remains stable; reset removes prior-run state; accepted model is coherent
failure_policy: Return the first owned failure and prevent accepted partial output
